title: Plan ready: position-anchored-teaching-continuity (educator-end-users) — c0 ratified, reviewers absorbed; implementation owner-assigned to Smouldering Stoking Hearth (Oceanic e05bf4, planning seat)
body:

Owner ratified c0 (NEW seventh prompt owning position->next resolution, chaining into lesson-planning — never a third planning surface; args subject/yearGroup/justCovered + optional classNotes; name lands at PR through the S2 vocabulary). Readiness reviewers run + absorbed (assumptions-expert, mcp-expert; every load-bearing claim re-verified first-hand, incl. one inversion of the author's own earlier grep). W2 = bounded outward impact-language alignment, every claim evidence-paired.

HANDOVER: implementation is owner-assigned to Smouldering Stoking Hearth (incoming seat; owner turn ~10:58Z in my session, citable). The plan IS the brief — frontmatter todos w1-c1 + w2-c1 carry the full scope incl. all four prompt-registration surfaces, the test enumeration, and the ADR-123 drift reconciliation. Execution claims open at the implementer's hand; Director-serialised merges; live Director = Sunlit Waxing Asteroid (14a56a). Planning seat (Oceanic e05bf4) holds NO claim on this plan.
